title: del.out~

messages.description: delay time in ms (or samples with -samps)

arguments.description: delay name (optional: default internal name relative to patch)
delay time in ms or samples

flags.name: -samps
flags.description: sets time value to samples (default is ms)

body: [del.out~] reads from a delay line written by a [del.in~] with the same name. The number of output channels in [del.out~] is the maximum of the number of input channels of [del.in~] and the number of input channels in [del.out~]. If both are of the same size, each input signal sets the delay time of a correspondent delay channel. In case the numbers mismatch, the smaller wraps around until reaching the number of the bigger one. So a single input value simply sets the delay time of all channels. Using more signal inputs than the available number of channels is useful for implementing a multitap delay.
